scope: Published-snapshot integrity (174 COPY_MANIFEST destinations against the manifest) plus the programme, design and exemplar checks. The live sibling trees are compared and their divergence is reported, not failed: they are actively developed workspaces that advance after publication, and an upstream advance is not damage to this repository. --strict-sibling restores the stronger contract.

copies.master_resource_check: Static loaded-resource attributes only; no browser acceptance

hash_format.rule: Full 64-character digests compare by equality; shorter lowercase hex values compare as prefixes

copies.sibling_source_identity: Compared and reported; a divergence is not a failure unless --strict-sibling is given

upstream_divergence.meaning: The live sibling Chemistry_1 through Chemistry_7 trees advanced after publication. The published copies still match COPY_MANIFEST.json; the upstream files moved on. Re-importing them is a decision for the task that owns the sibling workspace, because the published master digest is cited by the coverage island, the golden vectors, the method cards, the topic-4 family templates and the frozen bank.

preservation.scope: All regular non-symlink files under Chemistry_1 through Chemistry_7
preservation.meaning: The live sibling trees are compared with the inspection-time baseline. The baseline describes the source workspaces as they were at inspection; those workspaces keep being edited afterwards, so a difference is an upstream advance rather than damage to this repository. It fails the run only under --strict-sibling.

programme.page_render_review: Four Poppler PNGs directly inspected during preparation

roadmap.core_card_shape: 3 main steps; 2 subtasks with 3 substeps each

design_data.schema_check: Draft 2020-12 schema structure checked with installed jsonschema; no release instances exist
design_data.scope: Specifications only; no 112-item release bank or three assembled forms yet

examples.limit: Arithmetic and one structured balance; no official-key, complete scientific or learner-trial acceptance

not_performed: That the live sibling Chemistry_1 through Chemistry_7 trees still match the published copies (reported under checks.copies.upstream_divergence instead)
That the live sibling trees still match the inspection-time source-workspace baseline (reported under checks.preservation instead)

contract.pass_criterion: Every published copy matches COPY_MANIFEST.json (size and SHA-256); the published set is exactly the declared set; the programme, design and exemplar checks hold.
contract.reported_not_failed: A divergence between a live sibling source file and its published copy, and a drift against the source-workspace baseline.
contract.strict_flag: --strict-sibling turns the reported divergence into a failure.

not_asserted: That the live sibling Chemistry_1 through Chemistry_7 trees still match the published copies (reported under checks.copies.upstream_divergence instead)
That the live sibling trees still match the inspection-time source-workspace baseline (reported under checks.preservation instead)
